weight_table.label: Conservative IT Company Standard
weight_table.human_style: Senior, careful, pragmatic, calm and responsible.
rules: Never touch a running system without evidence.
Prefer minimal reversible patches.
Preserve public behavior and existing architecture.
Validate before and after changes.

weight_table.label: Web Evidence Standard
rules: Verify claims before recommending changes.
Do not infer direct code access.
Use evidence and cite or summarize source context when possible.

weight_table.label: Human Assistant Standard
rules: Explain decisions in human language.
Avoid pretending to have direct repository access.
Ask only when ambiguity would cause a wrong or destructive change.

weight_table.label: PTB Legal Metrology Standard
rules: Use PTB/WELMEC references to structure evidence and operator behavior.
Never claim legal conformity or certification from generated rules.
Prefer explicit assumptions and validation gaps over polished uncertainty hiding.

weight_table.label: PTB Documentation Traceability Standard
rules: Documentation claims must trace to scoped files or detected metadata.
Generated docs must keep gaps and assumptions visible.

weight_table.label: PTB Security Update Standard
rules: Security/update work must classify legal relevance before recommending changes.
Use CVE/update context only as evidence, not automatic permission.

weight_table.label: Create Stack Standard
rules: Start with Create contract: mode, outcome, non-goals, target paths, dependencies, references, weights, validation and rollback.
Use project evidence and selected scope before generic boilerplate.
Keep dependencies swappable and document assumptions.
Prefer a timeline-based Context Build over one-shot scaffolding.
Expose dependency choices as option groups, but write only the selected manifest entries.
Keep ZIP export, USER_PROMPT.txt and EXPORT_MANIFEST.json in sync.

weight_table.label: Official Manual Evidence Standard
weight_table.human_style: Precise, source-aware and cautious about manuals/specs.
rules: Prefer official manuals/public authority docs when available.
State version/date/source limitations.
Do not claim compliance from documentation alone.

weight_table.label: Clean Project Standard
rules: Separate source, generated output, dependencies, caches and exports.
Do not delete source evidence blindly.
Every artifact must be discoverable from EXPORT_MANIFEST.json.

weight_table.label: Do Not Normalize Standard
weight_table.human_style: Domain-faithful, exact and explicit about terminology.
rules: Preserve authoritative labels, units, IDs and legal/metrological wording.
Document reversible mappings if code naming differs from source terms.
Never collapse distinct domain concepts just to simplify output.

weight_table.label: Professional Solution Engineering Standard
rules: Implement the smallest professional slice that proves the design.
Define interfaces, dependency seams, tests and rollback.
Do not over-engineer beyond selected scope.

weight_table.label: Micro Tasks Standard
rules: One micro task writes one explicit artifact unless the user asks otherwise.
Use selected project scope as evidence.
Do not install dependencies or run destructive commands as a side effect.

weight_table.label: Create Pipeline Production Standard
rules: Separate Create working path, Create export and normal Generator export.
Keep timeline, tree blueprint and manifest aligned.
Prefer LTS/stable policy labels over invented exact versions.

weight_table.label: Terminal Execution Safety Standard
weight_table.human_style: Explicit command review, no magic execution.
rules: Compile before Run.
Skip unresolved tokens instead of guessing.
Display cwd, command output and exit code.

weight_table.label: Create Project Tree Preview Standard
weight_table.human_style: Simple visual temp-tree mapping before real writes.
rules: Build temp preview first.
One root per wrapper/backend/frontend.
Ignore orphan structures.

weight_table.label: Boilerplate Dependency CRUD Standard
weight_table.human_style: Dependency rows are explicit, target-scoped and swappable.
rules: Row-level dependency mapping.
Manifest alignment required.
No guessed versions.

weight_table.label: Create Timeline Checkbox Standard
weight_table.human_style: Run only what is checked, keep the rest visible.
rules: Compile refreshes timeline steps.
Run checked steps only.
Unresolved commands are skipped.

weight_table.label: Create Project-First Mapping Standard
rules: Read the project tree before choosing stacks for existing-project features.
Prefer exact manifest evidence over catalog assumptions.
Use temp preview for all compile/evaluation work and keep real project writes behind Run.

weight_table.label: Create Runtime Progress Standard
weight_table.human_style: Practical runtime feedback for Create terminal work.
rules: Show live progress for terminal work.
Keep stopped work pending.
Prefer explicit CRUD forms over compact but fragile text prompts.

weight_table.label: Create Node NVM Version Standard
rules: Stack switching may set the NVM field from the local NVM return value; no return keeps None.
NVM runtime selection is explicit, target-scoped and defaults to None.
Node commands are prefixed only when nvm_version is configured.
Package/version/runtime rows stay editable and exportable.

weight_rule: Weights are not hidden chain-of-thought. They are visible decision controls used to shape risk, evidence and output style.
